_doc: OSM + TIGER/Line street network (#229, user decision and download approval 2026-10-22, docs/03). vintage: the TIGER/Line year to use; a new vintage downloads into its own folder when first needed. coincide_m: a TIGER segment this close (most of its length) to an OSM way is that way, and only adds its names. snap_m: a TIGER segment end this close to an OSM node joins it there.
